commentary_settings_hint:
Enter the kind of AI, the model name and the address exactly as each AI publishes them (they are used as written).
Example  Claude: kind Claude (Anthropic), model claude-sonnet-5-5, address empty, variable ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Example  ChatGPT: kind OpenAI-compatible, address empty, variable OPENAI_API_KEY
Example  Gemini: kind OpenAI-compatible, address https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/, variable GEMINI_API_KEY
Example  DeepSeek: kind OpenAI-compatible, address https://api.deepseek.com, variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
Example  Ollama: kind OpenAI-compatible, address http://localhost:11434/v1
The API key itself is never saved. Set it in the environment variable before starting KentoGo.
To use the APIs, install the packages with `uv sync --extra ai`.
